name: Love at first bite
source:
Get ready for Love at First Bite, a LGBTQ+ friendly visual novel where you'll charm hot-as-hell vampires! Join their nefarious plots, win their hearts, and become the ultimate lackey. Romance, intrigue, and danger await, but so does comedy, nerdy references and just a hint of spice —Are you ready for it?

In this adventure you can live out your fantasy of stumbling into a vampire den and almost being murdered (but not).

Instead, you get a chance to prove the undead you're more than meets the eye. From your intriguing quirks to your unparalleled charm and endless stream of great choices, you'll sweep the monsters off their feet!(if you know what's best for you...)

Become the ultimate sidekick and aid them in their nefarious schemes, while also winning over their seemingly stone-cold hearts. Make them happy, make them proud, and ultimately make them fall madly in love with you.

What are you still doing here? Go get 'em! We're rooting for you!

[from [url=https://trianimastudio.itch.io/love-at-first-bite]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
准备好迎接《一口爱上》吧，这是一部LGBTQ+ 友好的视觉小说，你将在其中迷住火热的吸血鬼！加入他们的邪恶阴谋，赢得他们的心，成为最终的走狗。浪漫、阴谋和危险等待着你，但喜剧、书呆子的参考资料和一丝香料也在等待着你——你准备好了吗？

在这次冒险中，你可以实现自己的幻想：跌跌撞撞地进入吸血鬼巢穴，差点被谋杀（但不是）。

相反，你有机会证明你不仅仅是表面上看到的不死族。从你迷人的怪癖到你无与伦比的魅力和源源不断的绝佳选择，你将让怪物们大吃一惊！（如果你知道什么最适合你……）成为最终的助手，帮助他们实施邪恶的计划，同时赢得他们看似冷酷的心。让他们快乐，让他们自豪，最终让他们疯狂地爱上你。

你还在这里做什么？去抓他们吧！我们支持你！

[来自[url=https://trianimastudio.itch.io/love-at-first-bite]itch.io[/url]]
